payload.reason: The evidence indicates that dialogue systems can be built using various approaches, including off-the-shelf NLP systems, but also highlights the prevalence of rule-based and hybrid methods in industrial applications.

claims.text: Dialogue systems can utilize off-the-shelf NLP systems as part of their implementation.
Many industrial dialogue systems still rely on manual features or handcrafted rules, indicating a mix of approaches including off-the-shelf components.
